lessons.key: ac_gap::when a library maps an unknown error to a generic code baileys 500 read its source before treating that code as a permanent state like logout wiping credentials needs a code that only means that
lessons.text: When a library maps an unknown error to a generic code (Baileys: 500), read its source before treating that code as a permanent state like logout; wiping credentials needs a code that only means that.

lessons.key: weak_test::a test for a resolution order must make the lower priority source return a different value and assert it was not asked a source that returns null passes under any order
lessons.text: A test for a resolution order must make the lower-priority source return a different value and assert it was not asked; a source that returns null passes under any order.
